title: In IELTS Academic Writing Task 2, which of the following linking phrases is most appropriate to introduce a contrasting argument?
options: On the other hand
In addition
Furthermore
Consequently
answer: On the other hand

title: Choose the best academic synonym for the word 'important' to use in an IELTS essay.
options: Crucial
Big
Nice
Famous
answer: Crucial

title: Identify the grammatically correct inversion structure used for emphasis in advanced writing.
options: Not only did they lose the match, but they also faced a penalty.
Not only they lost the match, but they also faced a penalty.
Not only did they lost the match, but they also faced a penalty.
Not only they did lose the match, but they also faced a penalty.
answer: Not only did they lose the match, but they also faced a penalty.

title: In IELTS Reading, if a text says a phenomenon is 'ubiquitous', it means the phenomenon is...
options: found everywhere
very rare
extremely dangerous
completely new
answer: found everywhere

title: Complete the sentence with the correct conditional form: 'If governments ________ more funds to green energy earlier, global warming might not be as severe today.'
options: had allocated
allocated
would allocate
have allocated
answer: had allocated

title: Which of the following verbs means 'to increase rapidly' and is highly useful for describing trends in IELTS Writing Task 1?
options: Rocket
Plunge
Fluctuate
Stabilize
answer: Rocket

title: What is the meaning of the academic word 'mitigate' often found in environmental or social texts in IELTS?
options: To make something less severe or harmful
To increase the size of something
To starting a new project
To approve a law officially
answer: To make something less severe or harmful

title: Choose the correct prepositional phrase to complete the sentence: 'The chart shows a dramatic rise in smartphone users, ________ contrast to the previous decade.'
options: in sharp
with big
by heavy
for clear
answer: in sharp

title: Which sentence uses a complex noun phrase acting as a subject, suitable for a band 7+ IELTS essay?
options: The rapid degradation of natural habitats poses a significant threat to biodiversity.
Natural habitats are degrading rapidly and this threatens biodiversity a lot.
Biodiversity is threatened because habitats are destroying very fast.
Habitats destroy fast, so it is a big threat to biodiversity.
answer: The rapid degradation of natural habitats poses a significant threat to biodiversity.

title: In IELTS Listening, if a speaker says 'I'd rather opt for the latter option,' which option do they prefer?
options: The second of two options mentioned
The first of two options mentioned
Neither of the options
A completely new option
answer: The second of two options mentioned

title: What is a suitable academic substitute for the phrase 'a lot of problems' in an IELTS essay?
options: A myriad of challenges
Many bad things
Tons of troubles
A bunch of issues
answer: A myriad of challenges

title: Identify the passive structure that correctly introduces an objective, general opinion in writing.
options: It is widely believed that technology hampers face-to-face communication.
People are widely believing that technology hampers communication.
It widely believes that technology hampers communication.
Technology is widely believed to hampering communication.
answer: It is widely believed that technology hampers face-to-face communication.

title: In IELTS Reading, if an author describes a finding as 'spurious', they mean that the finding is...
options: false or fake
highly accurate
very historical
easy to understand
answer: false or fake

title: Complete the sentence with the correct relative pronoun: 'Automation is a double-edged sword, the consequences ________ are still being debated by economists.'
options: of which
with whom
that
where
answer: of which

title: Which phrase is used to introduce the conclusion paragraph in an IELTS Writing Task 2 essay?
options: In conclusion
To finish my words
At the end of day
By the way
answer: In conclusion

title: If a line graph shows a pattern going up and down repeatedly, how should you describe this trend in Task 1?
options: The figures fluctuated over the period.
The figures remained steady over the period.
The figures plunged dramatically over the period.
The figures peaked sharply over the period.
answer: The figures fluctuated over the period.

title: What does the academic word 'detrimental' mean when describing the effects of a habit or policy?
options: Harmful or damaging
Beneficial and helpful
Temporary or short-term
Inexpensive or cheap
answer: Harmful or damaging

title: Choose the sentence that correctly utilizes a participle clause to combine two actions efficiently.
options: Having completed the survey, the researchers analyzed the data.
Completed the survey, the researchers analyzed the data.
The researchers analyzed the data having completed the survey.
Survey was completed, the researchers analyzed data.
answer: Having completed the survey, the researchers analyzed the data.

title: In IELTS Speaking Part 3, which phrase helps buy you time to think while maintaining a natural, high-level vocabulary flow?
options: That's a thought-provoking question, let me consider it.
I don't know the answer for this.
Wait a minute, please.
Repeat the question again.
answer: That's a thought-provoking question, let me consider it.

title: Which word represents the concept of 'the basic physical and organizational structures needed for the operation of a society'?
options: Infrastructure
Demographics
Urbanization
Globalization
answer: Infrastructure

title: In advanced academic writing, certain verbs require the subjunctive mood (base form of the verb). Choose the correct option: 'It is imperative that the government ________ immediate action.'
options: take
takes
took
has taken
answer: take

title: Which 'Cleft sentence' structure is correctly used to place strong emphasis on the cause of a problem in an IELTS Task 2 essay?
options: It is the lack of education that drives high crime rates, not poverty.
What drives high crime rates it is the lack of education, not poverty.
The lack of education it is that drives high crime rates, not poverty.
It is driving high crime rates because of the lack of education.
answer: It is the lack of education that drives high crime rates, not poverty.

title: In IELTS Writing Task 1, if a pie chart shows that an item accounts for exactly 75% of the total, which academic fraction is best to use?
options: A vast majority consisting of three-quarters
The minor part of three-fourths
Roughly a third of the overall total
A small fraction of three parts
answer: A vast majority consisting of three-quarters

title: In IELTS Reading, if the text states that an ecosystem is 'on the brink of collapse', it means the ecosystem is...
options: extremely close to collapsing
recovering very successfully
completely safe from dangers
monitored by global scientists
answer: extremely close to collapsing

title: Choose the correct academic collocation that means 'to have a massive and influential effect' on something.
options: Exert a profound impact
Make a giant result
Give a heavy influence
Do a serious output
answer: Exert a profound impact

title: Complete the sentence with the correct advanced adverbial phrase: 'The data indicates that carbon emissions rose steadily, ________ outperforming initial environmental forecasts.'
options: thereby
whereas
nevertheless
nonetheless
answer: thereby

title: What does the advanced vocabulary word 'unprecedented' mean when describing a modern social or economic trend?
options: Never done or known before
Very old-fashioned and ancient
Happening on a regular basis
Negative and highly controversial
answer: Never done or known before

title: In IELTS Writing Task 1, which structure is ideal to compare two opposing trends simultaneously within a single complex sentence?
options: While the consumption of coal dropped significantly, that of solar energy experienced a sharp growth.
The consumption of coal dropped significantly, but solar energy was growing up too.
Coal consumption dropped down, whereas solar energy also went up in the same time.
Although coal consumption decreased, but solar energy increased rapidly instead.
answer: While the consumption of coal dropped significantly, that of solar energy experienced a sharp growth.

title: Identify the correct nominal clause structure functioning as the subject of the sentence.
options: Whether governments should censor the internet remains a highly debated topic.
That governments should censor the internet it is a highly debated topic.
Should governments censor the internet is remaining a highly debated topic.
If governments should censor the internet remaining a debated topic.
answer: Whether governments should censor the internet remains a highly debated topic.

title: In IELTS Listening, if the receptionist says, 'The seminar has been brought forward by two days,' what does it mean?
options: The seminar will happen two days earlier than planned.
The seminar has been delayed or postponed by two days.
The seminar will last for two extra days.
The seminar has been canceled completely.
answer: The seminar will happen two days earlier than planned.

title: Which of the following phrases is a formal academic alternative for the informal expression 'to deal with a problem'?
options: To address an issue
To fight a trouble
To clear a mess
To sort out an argument
answer: To address an issue

title: What is the meaning of the academic adjective 'imperative' often used in problem-solution essays?
options: Crucial or absolutely necessary
Optional or voluntary
Outdated and useless
Extremely cheap or economical
answer: Crucial or absolutely necessary

title: In IELTS Reading, if a writer claims that a theory has been 'refuted', it means the theory has been...
options: proven to be false
accepted globally
discovered recently
modified slightly
answer: proven to be false

title: Choose the sentence that correctly uses a reduced relative clause to make the academic writing more concise.
options: The measures implemented by the council successfully reduced urban traffic.
The measures which implemented by the council successfully reduced traffic.
The measures implementing by the council successfully reduced urban traffic.
The measures were implemented by the council successfully reduced traffic.
answer: The measures implemented by the council successfully reduced urban traffic.

title: Which word means 'the movement of individuals from rural areas into expanding cities' and is a frequent topic in Task 2?
options: Urbanization
Migration
Industrialization
Congestion
answer: Urbanization

title: In IELTS Task 1 process diagrams, which linking sequence is the most sophisticated way to transition to the final stage?
options: In the final stage of the process, the packaged goods are subsequently distributed.
At last step, the goods are packing and going to shops.
Finally of all, the goods distribute to markets after packing.
To end the process, the goods are then sending away.
answer: In the final stage of the process, the packaged goods are subsequently distributed.

title: What does the academic term 'indispensable' mean when talking about tools, resources, or skills?
options: Absolutely essential; cannot be done without
Easily replaceable and disposable
Very expensive to maintain
Hard to learn or master
answer: Absolutely essential; cannot be done without

title: Choose the grammatically correct negative adverbial structure used to start a sentence with inversion.
options: Rarely do scientists encounter such perfectly preserved specimens.
Rarely scientists encounter such perfectly preserved specimens.
Rarely do scientists encountered such perfectly preserved specimens.
Rarely scientists do encounter such perfectly preserved specimens.
answer: Rarely do scientists encounter such perfectly preserved specimens.

title: In IELTS Speaking Part 3, if you want to politely disagree with a general statement, which phrase sounds most academic?
options: That might be true to some extent, however, I believe there are other factors.
No, that is completely wrong in my opinion.
I don't think so because it is not real.
You are wrong, but let me say my own point.
answer: That might be true to some extent, however, I believe there are other factors.

title: Which of the following verbs is the most precise synonym for 'to cause or trigger' a sudden change or reaction?
options: Precipitate
Accompany
Hinder
Postpone
answer: Precipitate

title: In IELTS Academic Writing, 'hedging' is used to avoid overgeneralization. Which sentence correctly applies hedging to sound more objective?
options: Excessive screen time tends to contribute to sedentary lifestyles among adolescents.
Excessive screen time definitely causes sedentary lifestyles among adolescents.
Every single adolescent gets a sedentary lifestyle because of excessive screen time.
Excessive screen time always results in adolescents becoming lazy.
answer: Excessive screen time tends to contribute to sedentary lifestyles among adolescents.

title: Choose the correct advanced linker of concession to complete this sentence: '________ the high initial costs of installing solar panels, the long-term economic benefits are undeniable.'
options: Notwithstanding
Although
Even though
Whereas
answer: Notwithstanding

title: In IELTS Writing Task 1, when describing a map where an old factory was completely replaced by a new stadium, which verb is most appropriate?
options: Superceded by
Demolished into
Expanded with
Renovated as
answer: Superceded by

title: In IELTS Reading, if an article mentions that a scientific discovery was 'accidental', which academic synonym is the author likely to use in the text?
options: Serendipitous
Deliberate
Calculated
Systematic
answer: Serendipitous

title: Some verbs change their meaning depending on whether they are followed by a gerund or an infinitive. What does 'The researchers stopped to interview the subjects' mean?
options: They paused their previous activity in order to conduct the interview.
They finished the process of interviewing the subjects forever.
They completely avoided interviewing the subjects.
They kept interviewing the subjects without any interruption.
answer: They paused their previous activity in order to conduct the interview.

title: Which phrase is the most formal way to express that something is a direct consequence of a previous action in Task 2?
options: As a direct corollary of this,
Because of this thing happening,
And that's why it brings,
Just like this made,
answer: As a direct corollary of this,

title: What is the meaning of the academic word 'exacerbate' when analyzing social or economic issues?
options: To make a problem or bad situation worse
To solve a complex crisis completely
To explain the background of a situation
To decrease the intensity of an argument
answer: To make a problem or bad situation worse

title: In IELTS Writing Task 1, if you want to describe a small town that sits exactly on the edge of a massive river, which prepositional collocation is correct?
options: Situated on the banks of the river
Located inside the side of the river
Positioned over the borders of the river
Placed at the shores of the river
answer: Situated on the banks of the river

title: Identify the sentence that uses a complex advanced modal structure to draw a logical conclusion about a past event.
options: The ancient civilization must have experienced severe droughts to abandon such a fertile valley.
The ancient civilization must experience severe droughts to abandon such a fertile valley.
The ancient civilization should have experienced severe droughts for abandoning a valley.
The ancient civilization might experience severe droughts because they abandoned a valley.
answer: The ancient civilization must have experienced severe droughts to abandon such a fertile valley.

title: In IELTS Listening, if an advisor says, 'The tuition fee is inclusive of all seminar materials,' what does it mean for the student?
options: The materials are provided with no additional cost.
The student needs to buy the materials separately.
The materials are optional and not required.
The student will get a partial refund for materials later.
answer: The materials are provided with no additional cost.

title: Which of the following expressions is the most advanced way to introduce the concept of 'advantages and disadvantages' in an essay introduction?
options: The merits and demerits of this phenomenon
The good points and bad sides of this thing
The pluses and minuses of this event
The positive things and negative issues of this topic
answer: The merits and demerits of this phenomenon

title: What does the academic term 'stagnant' mean when used to describe economic growth or a country's development?
options: Showing no activity; dull and not growing
Developing at an incredibly rapid pace
Changing constantly and unpredictably
Declining to a dangerously low level
answer: Showing no activity; dull and not growing

title: In IELTS Reading, if a text says that a certain custom is 'deeply ingrained' in a society, it implies that the custom is...
options: firmly established and difficult to change
recently introduced and unpopular
completely forgotten by younger generations
forbidden by the national laws
answer: firmly established and difficult to change

title: Choose the sentence that correctly utilizes a complex conditional clause without using the word 'if' (omission of if with inversion).
options: Had the company invested in market research, they would have avoided bankruptcy.
Did the company invest in market research, they would avoid bankruptcy.
Have the company invested in market research, they would avoid bankruptcy.
Should the company invested in market research, they avoided bankruptcy.
answer: Had the company invested in market research, they would have avoided bankruptcy.

title: Which of the following words describes 'a situation in which a country or organization imports more than it exports'?
options: Deficit
Surplus
Inflation
Revenue
answer: Deficit

title: In IELTS Writing Task 1, when summarizing a trend that reached its highest value before dropping, which phrase is most accurate?
options: The percentage peaked at 45% in 2010 before declining.
The percentage did a top of 45% in 2010 then it went down.
The percentage finished its maximum at 45% in 2010 and dropped.
The percentage stood at its high point of 45% in 2010 and then decreased.
answer: The percentage peaked at 45% in 2010 before declining.

title: What does the formal academic word 'discrepancy' mean when comparing two sets of statistical data?
options: A lack of compatibility or similarity between facts
A perfect correlation between two different variables
The total sum of all numbers collected
The speed at which data changes over time
answer: A lack of compatibility or similarity between facts

title: Choose the option that uses an appropriate advanced adverb to express that a change was 'visible and easy to notice' but not necessarily huge.
options: The employment rate grew perceptibly over the quarter.
The employment rate grew gigantically over the quarter.
The employment rate grew shockingly over the quarter.
The employment rate grew massively over the quarter.
answer: The employment rate grew perceptibly over the quarter.

title: In IELTS Speaking Part 3, if you want to say that a problem affects everyone regardless of their background, which idiomatic academic phrase is best?
options: This issue cuts across all socio-economic boundaries.
This issue goes over all rich and poor people.
This issue breaks down every single family.
This issue touches everyone's pocket directly.
answer: This issue cuts across all socio-economic boundaries.

title: Which word represents the concept of 'the standard of living, health, and happiness experienced by an individual or group'?
options: Well-being
Demography
Sustenance
Affluence
answer: Well-being

title: In high-level academic writing, 'nominalization' (turning verbs into nouns) makes the tone more objective. Which sentence shows the best use of nominalization?
options: The implementation of the new policy led to a significant reduction in waste.
When they implemented the new policy, they reduced waste significantly.
Implementing the new policy was good because it significantly reduced waste.
The policy was implemented and it helped to reduce waste in a significant way.
answer: The implementation of the new policy led to a significant reduction in waste.

title: Choose the correct advanced relative pronoun structure to complete this sentence: 'The city council introduced strict zoning laws, ________ the expansion of commercial zones was heavily restricted.'
options: underneath which
whereby
at whose
forwarding which
answer: whereby

title: In IELTS Writing Task 1, if a trend increases sharply and then remains completely flat for several years, which academic phrase best describes the flat period?
options: The figure reached a plateau and remained stable.
The figure experienced a continuous fluctuation.
The figure hit the lowest trough of the period.
The figure plummeted consistently without stopping.
answer: The figure reached a plateau and remained stable.

title: In IELTS Reading, if a text mentions that a claim is 'unsubstantiated', it means the claim is...
options: not supported by any valid evidence
proven to be absolutely true and final
written by an anonymous author
extremely dangerous to the public
answer: not supported by any valid evidence

title: Identify the sentence that uses 'fronting' (placing an adverbial phrase at the very beginning without inversion) to improve cohesion and flow between paragraphs.
options: Against this background of economic instability, many small businesses failed.
Many small businesses failed against this background of economic instability.
Failed many small businesses against this background of economic instability.
Economic instability background was against this, so small businesses failed.
answer: Against this background of economic instability, many small businesses failed.

title: Which of the following complex structures is best suited to express a strong personal stance in an IELTS Task 2 introduction?
options: I am firmly of the opinion that the disadvantages of this trend far outweigh its benefits.
I think that the bad sides of this are more than the good sides.
My personal thinking is that negative things are bigger than positive items.
I will say that the drawbacks are heavier than the advantages of this issue.
answer: I am firmly of the opinion that the disadvantages of this trend far outweigh its benefits.

title: What does the academic vocabulary word 'ubiquity' mean when analyzing modern phenomena like smartphones or the internet?
options: The state of being very common or present everywhere
The sudden collapse of an advanced industry
The high cost associated with luxury technology
The strict regulation of modern digital media
answer: The state of being very common or present everywhere

title: In IELTS Writing Task 1, when comparing data where one category is double the size of another, which advanced structure is grammatically correct?
options: The proportion of households recycling plastic was twice as high as that of households recycling paper.
The proportion of households recycling plastic was two times higher than households recycling paper.
households recycling plastic was double more than households recycling paper.
Recycling plastic households were two times as much as recycling paper.
answer: The proportion of households recycling plastic was twice as high as that of households recycling paper.

title: Choose the sentence that correctly utilizes a complex concession clause with 'In spite of' followed by a gerund or noun phrase.
options: In spite of facing severe budget cuts, the university managed to upgrade its research facilities.
In spite of the university faced severe budget cuts, they managed to upgrade research facilities.
In spite of severe budget cuts were faced, the university managed to upgrade facilities.
In spite of the university managed to upgrade facilities, they faced severe budget cuts.
answer: In spite of facing severe budget cuts, the university managed to upgrade its research facilities.

title: In IELTS Listening Section 4, if a lecturer describes a project as 'economically viable', what do they mean?
options: The project is financially feasible and capable of working successfully.
The project is way too expensive and will cause massive debt.
The project relies entirely on voluntary charity donations.
The project has been canceled due to sudden budget shortages.
answer: The project is financially feasible and capable of working successfully.

title: Which of the following academic collocations is the most sophisticated way to say 'to play a critical role' in achieving a goal?
options: To be instrumental in achieving
To be a major tool for making
To do a massive job in building
To act as a key machine for doing
answer: To be instrumental in achieving

title: What does the formal adjective 'counterproductive' mean when evaluating the outcome of a governmental strategy?
options: Having the opposite of the desired effect; completely hindering progress
Increasing industrial output at an unprecedented speed
Requiring double the amount of human labor and machinery
Being highly profitable for private independent companies
answer: Having the opposite of the desired effect; completely hindering progress

title: In IELTS Reading, if a text states that two distinct variables have an 'inverse relationship', it implies that...
options: as one variable increases, the other variable decreases
both variables increase simultaneously at the same exact rate
there is absolutely no logical connection between the two variables
one variable is the direct ancestor or historical cause of the other
answer: as one variable increases, the other variable decreases

title: Complete the sentence with the correct advanced prepositional phrase: 'Online learning offers immense flexibility; ________, it can lead to a sense of isolation among students.'
options: by token of this
by the same token
in light of this
on the grounds of
answer: by the same token

title: Which academic word represents 'the process of turning a global or abstract idea into a concrete, measurable reality or entity'?
options: Manifestation
Diversification
Stagnation
Procrastination
answer: Manifestation

title: In IELTS Writing Task 1, when describing a process diagram where one step must happen at the exact same time as another, which adverb is best?
options: Simultaneously
Subsequently
Consecutively
Retrospectively
answer: Simultaneously

title: What does the high-level vocabulary word 'cognitive' refer to in academic texts regarding education or psychology?
options: Relating to the mental processes of perception, memory, and thinking
Connected strictly to physical exercise and muscular strength
Associated with financial systems and international bank trades
Pertaining to ancient architectural structures and city maps
answer: Relating to the mental processes of perception, memory, and thinking

title: Choose the option that uses an appropriate advanced adjective to describe a change that was 'so small or minor that it had almost no effect'.
options: The shift in consumer preferences was negligible.
The shift in consumer preferences was monumental.
The shift in consumer preferences was fundamental.
The shift in consumer preferences was drastic.
answer: The shift in consumer preferences was negligible.

title: In IELTS Speaking Part 3, if you want to say that traditional methods are becoming obsolete because of new technology, which phrase is most natural and high-level?
options: Conventional practices are gradually being superseded by technological advancements.
Old ways of doing things are dying fast because computers are coming.
Traditional systems are losing their life due to fresh machines.
Historical methods are completely broken because of modern engineering tools.
answer: Conventional practices are gradually being superseded by technological advancements.

title: Which academic word represents 'a situation where people are forced to leave their homes or traditional lands due to conflict, environmental disasters, or urban development'?
options: Displacement
Integration
Allocation
Assimilation
answer: Displacement

title: Which 'Pseudo-cleft sentence' structure is best utilized to emphasize a specific finding or result in IELTS Writing Task 1?
options: What the data highlights is a disproportionate rise in renewable energy adoption.
That the data highlights it is a disproportionate rise in renewable energy adoption.
A disproportionate rise in renewable energy adoption is what does the data highlight.
What is highlighted by the data it is a disproportionate rise in energy.
answer: What the data highlights is a disproportionate rise in renewable energy adoption.

title: Choose the option that correctly uses the advanced concession linker 'albeit' to qualify an adjective within an academic context.
options: The project was highly successful, albeit incredibly expensive to execute.
Albeit the project was successful, it was very expensive to execute.
The project was successful albeit it cost a lot of money to finish.
The project was successful, albeit was costing a large amount of money.
answer: The project was highly successful, albeit incredibly expensive to execute.

title: In IELTS Writing Task 1, if a line graph displays wild, unpredictable, and erratic movements up and down, which noun phrase is best to describe this behavior?
options: The figure exhibited a high degree of volatility throughout the period.
The figure experienced a systematic plateau over the years.
The figure maintained a uniform trajectory during the decade.
The figure underwent a marginal reduction before stabilizing.
answer: The figure exhibited a high degree of volatility throughout the period.

title: In IELTS Reading, if an author mentions a 'paradigm shift' in a particular field of science, they mean...
options: a fundamental change in approach or underlying assumptions
a slight financial error made during data collection
a historical disagreement between two rival researchers
a rapid acceleration in the speed of mechanical manufacturing
answer: a fundamental change in approach or underlying assumptions

title: Identify the grammatically correct inversion structure starting with a limiting prepositional phrase for Academic Writing Task 2.
options: Under no circumstances should governments compromise the privacy of citizens.
Under no circumstances governments should compromise the privacy of citizens.
Under no circumstances governments compromise the privacy of citizens.
Under no circumstances should governments to compromise the privacy of citizens.
answer: Under no circumstances should governments compromise the privacy of citizens.

title: Complete the sentence with the correct advanced purposeful structure: 'Local councils are investing in modern public transport, ________ reducing urban traffic congestion.'
options: with a view to
in order to
so as to
for the purpose
answer: with a view to

title: What does the academic word 'plausible' mean when evaluating an explanation or a hypothesis in a Reading text?
options: Reasonable or probable; completely believable
Highly controversial and widely rejected
Outdated and no longer applicable to modern times
Strictly confidential and restricted from the public
answer: Reasonable or probable; completely believable

title: In IELTS Writing Task 2, which advanced transitional adverb is best used to introduce a statement that contrasts directly with the preceding one?
options: Conversely
Furthermore
Inadvertently
Correspondingly
answer: Conversely

title: Choose the correct sentence that uses a complex noun-complement clause starting with 'The notion that...' to introduce a widely held belief.
options: The notion that economic growth automatically cures poverty is increasingly being questioned.
The notion which economic growth automatically cures poverty is questioning a lot.
The notion that economic growth automatically cures poverty it is questioned.
The notion where economic growth automatically cures poverty remains questioning.
answer: The notion that economic growth automatically cures poverty is increasingly being questioned.

title: In IELTS Listening, if an applicant states, 'I was under the impression that the workshop was free,' it implies that...
options: they mistakenly believed the workshop did not cost anything
they knew exactly how much the workshop cost in advance
they are refusing to attend the workshop due to prices
they have already paid for the workshop online
answer: they mistakenly believed the workshop did not cost anything

title: Which of the following verbs is the most precise academic synonym for 'to support or confirm a statement, theory, or finding' with data?
options: Corroborate
Contradict
Jeopardize
Undermine
answer: Corroborate

title: What does the academic term 'empirical' mean when describing research, data, or evidence in a text?
options: Based on verifiable observation or experience rather than pure theory
Derived completely from ancient historical myths and folklore
Calculated incorrectly due to malfunctioning laboratory equipment
Sponsored entirely by multinational corporate corporations
answer: Based on verifiable observation or experience rather than pure theory

title: In IELTS Reading, if a passage claims that a certain factor is the 'catalyst' for a social movement, it means the factor...
options: accelerates or precipitates the development of the event
completely stops the event from happening further
is the final negative consequence of the entire event
is a hidden financial cost associated with the event
answer: accelerates or precipitates the development of the event

title: Choose the sentence that correctly utilizes a complex future-in-the-past structure to describe a projected trend from a historical perspective.
options: In 2000, experts predicted that automated systems would dominate the manufacturing sector by 2020.
In 2000, experts predicted that automated systems will dominate the manufacturing sector by 2020.
In 2000, experts predicted that automated systems dominate the manufacturing sector by 2020.
In 2000, experts predicted that automated systems are going to dominate manufacturing by 2020.
answer: In 2000, experts predicted that automated systems would dominate the manufacturing sector by 2020.

title: Which of the following academic collocations is the most sophisticated way to describe 'the main features or points' of a map or chart in Writing Task 1?
options: The salient features of the diagram
The main good points of the picture
The big shapes of the graphics
The noticeable parts of the chart
answer: The salient features of the diagram

title: In IELTS Writing Task 1 process diagrams, which grammatical aspect is ideal for describing a step that must be fully completed before another starts?
options: Once the raw materials have been sorted, they are transferred to the conveyor belt.
Once the raw materials sort, they are transfer to the conveyor belt.
Once the raw materials are sorting, they will transfer to the conveyor belt.
Once the raw materials had been sorting, they transferred to the conveyor belt.
answer: Once the raw materials have been sorted, they are transferred to the conveyor belt.

title: What does the formal academic noun 'propensity' mean when describing human behavior or social trends?
options: An inclination or natural tendency to behave in a particular way
A complete lack of interest or total apathy towards a topic
A sudden financial loss experienced by large households
The legal right to vote in local government elections
answer: An inclination or natural tendency to behave in a particular way

title: Choose the option that uses an appropriate advanced adverb to indicate that a change happened 'gradually and in small stages over a long period'.
options: The literacy rate increased incrementally over the course of fifty years.
The literacy rate increased abruptly over the course of fifty years.
The literacy rate increased spontaneously over the course of fifty years.
The literacy rate increased drastically over the course of fifty years.
answer: The literacy rate increased incrementally over the course of fifty years.
